artist_facing_records.title: Three-month residency for international artists at Westwerk
artist_facing_records.provider: Hamburg Ministry for Culture and Media / Westwerk
artist_facing_records.funding: €900 monthly allowance, rent-free live-work accommodation, one return journey, and €500 final-presentation subsidy

artist_facing_records.title: Beyond the Silence
artist_facing_records.original_title: Beyond the Silence / Đâm Toạc Chân Mây
artist_facing_records.funding: Up to €2,000 per selected project; up to four projects selected
artist_facing_records.geographic_matching_note: The public call does not state applicant geography precisely enough for an automatic country decision.

artist_facing_records.title: Temporary relocation for artists and cultural actors at risk in Germany
artist_facing_records.funding: Monthly scholarship for up to 15 months, individual support, work resources, host support, and visa-process assistance; amounts are not publicly stated
artist_facing_records.privacy_note: Threat and safety evidence must never be exposed through public profiles or institution discovery.

artist_facing_records.title: Bridges Residency
artist_facing_records.provider: AICA International / Cité internationale des arts
artist_facing_records.funding: At least €1,000 monthly stipend net of taxes, live-in studio, and up to €1,000 for international travel, travel insurance, and visa costs

artist_facing_records.title: Colours of Humanity Arts Exhibition 2026
artist_facing_records.provider: European Union Office to Hong Kong and Macao / Goethe-Institut Hong Kong / Eaton HK
artist_facing_records.funding: Free exhibition opportunity; up to HK$8,000 honorarium for a selected community programme; grand prize includes a two-week Eaton residency

artist_facing_records.title: AOCA — Appui aux opérateurs culturels en Afrique 2027
artist_facing_records.funding: €5,000–€15,000, covering up to 50% of the project’s total budget
